        emp.EMPLOYEE_ID,

    GROUP BY ROOT_MANAGER

    SELECT ROOT_MANAGER
    FROM max_depth
    WHERE MAX_LEVEL >= 3
),

    SELECT 
        et.ROOT_MANAGER,
        SUM(e.SALARY) AS TOTAL_TEAM_SALARY

    JOIN employees e ON e.EMPLOYEE_ID = et.CURRENT_EMP

WITH region_year AS (
    SELECT r.REGION_NAME,
           CAST(strftime('%Y', e.HIRE_DATE) AS INTEGER) AS hire_year,
           COUNT(*) AS hires,
           AVG(e.SALARY) AS avg_salary
    FROM employees e
    JOIN departments d ON e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
    JOIN locations l ON d.LOCATION_ID = l.LOCATION_ID
    JOIN countries c ON l.COUNTRY_ID = c.COUNTRY_ID
    JOIN regions r ON c.REGION_ID = r.REGION_ID
    GROUP BY r.REGION_NAME, hire_year
)
SELECT hires,
       SUM(hires) OVER (PARTITION BY REGION_NAME ORDER BY hire_year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total,
       avg_salary
FROM region_year
ORDER BY REGION_NAME, hire_year;
